title: Mary Elva Morgan Mosley
clean_html:
Mary Elva Morgan Mosley

Preserved Primary Document • morgan-m.htm

photo taken by John Carter Mary Elva was the daughter of Edward Morgan and Mamie Durham . She was born in Fairton, NJ on May 04, 1927. After the death of her mother in 1929 she was sent to live with her uncle Leomond Morgan and she continued to live with him after her father and sisters moved back to Delaware. In 1948, she married Ernest Glendon Mosley, the son of Joseph Hamilton Mosley and Alberta Carney.
